purpose: Classify the September 7 country enrichment/node batch manifests after the country atlas reached canonical 195-country coverage.
conclusion: The 18 batch/node files are rollout/migration bookkeeping rather than active country knowledge. Canonical country content lives in data/countries/*.json plus current country/world-map registries. Retain the manifests for historical provenance, but do not count them as active country-atlas holdings.
